newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks flatten ahead of Jospin speech.
newsitem.headline: French stocks flatten ahead of Jospin speech.

text.p: French stocks were little changed at midday as the bourse waited for new Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's keynote policy address, due to begin at 1300 GMT.
"The bourse is holding up. People hope it'll be a moderate message," a broker said. "We're just waiting. It's very calm."
* CAC-40 index was down 0.39 point, or 0.01 percent, at 2,751.35 at 1038 GMT, with gains prompting profit-taking
* CAC-40 June futures contract down one at 2,747
* Moulinex up 3.15 percent after reporting return to profit for 1996/97 year ended March 31
